name: z-subagent-workflow
description: Subagent orchestration for zcode: lifecycle management (start/list/status/cancel/message/close) of headless subagent sessions with agent .md reuse, model routing, worktree isolation, structured outputs and mailbox completion notification. Complements the engine-native background agents with capabilities they lack (isolation, conversation, schema, four-root agent discovery, cross-window records).

description_i18n.en: Subagent orchestration for zcode: lifecycle management (start/list/status/cancel/message/close) of headless subagent sessions with agent .md reuse, model routing, worktree isolation, structured outputs and mailbox completion notification. Complements the engine-native background agents with capabilities they lack (isolation, conversation, schema outputs, four-root agent discovery, cross-window records).
description_i18n.zh-CN: zcode 的 subagent 编排：无头子会话的生命周期管理（start/list/status/cancel/message/close），复用 agent .md 生态、模型路由、worktree 隔离、结构化输出与 mailbox 完成通知。与引擎原生后台 agent 互补——补足原生缺少的隔离、续聊、schema 输出、四根 agent 发现与跨窗口记录。
